observations: Photo 0 shows a black two-burner gas cooker with visible signs of use: discoloration and residue on the burners and grates, minor scratches on the surface.
Photo 1 shows the original packaging box with 'KENWOOD' branding and 'MODEL: KWD903' clearly visible on the side.
The box is partially open, revealing the cooker inside, matching the one in photo 0.
The box appears slightly worn but intact, with no visible damage to the product itself.
No control knobs or ignition system are visible in either photo.

claims.claim: Neatly used Kenwood Premium Household Gas Cooker
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a clean and intact cooker with only minor signs of use; photo 1 confirms the brand and model.

claims.claim: Used only a few times and still in excellent condition
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows some discoloration and residue on burners, which may indicate more than a few uses; no proof of usage frequency or full condition (e.g., knobs, ignition, interior).

risks.risk: The cooktop may not ignite or function properly due to unseen damage or wear in the ignition system or gas valves.
risks.proof: A close-up video or photo showing the control knobs, ignition button, and flame when lit.

risks.risk: The burners may have clogged ports or reduced gas flow, affecting performance.
risks.proof: A close-up photo or video of the burner heads with gas lit, showing even flame distribution.

risks.risk: The cooktop may have hidden damage to the body or gas connections not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A photo showing the underside and gas connection points, or a video of the cooktop being turned on and off.

proof_requests: Video or photo of the cooktop being lit to show ignition and flame performance.
Close-up of the control knobs and ignition system.
Photo of the underside and gas connection points.
response.reason: The brand and model are confirmed, but critical functional aspects like ignition, flame performance, and internal condition are not visible. Without proof of working condition, the item cannot be priced accurately and carries significant functional risk.
